horizons: 1..7 years; forecasts use horizons 3..7 from 2024 origin

scenario_assumptions.dry: rainfall x0.80, rain-day counts x0.85, heavy-event metrics x0.90, dry-spell metrics x1.20
scenario_assumptions.wet: rainfall x1.20, rain-day counts x1.15, heavy-event metrics x1.10, dry-spell metrics x0.85
scenario_assumptions.temperature: recent 10-year linear historical trend; no invented seasonal forecast

target_leakage_protection: future target yield is never used as an input
future area is not taken from target-year actuals; only origin area and historical area slope are used
current validated 2024 model is not modified
